rows: Financial Visibility | View financial data including rates, fee estimates, and profitability reports
Billing | Create, edit, and send fee notes to clients
Matter Management | Create and manage matters, tasks, and documents
Team Oversight | View team members' work, time entries, and assignments
Client Management | Create and manage client records and relationships
Automations | Configure workflow automations and scheduling rules
View Trust | View trust account balances, transactions, and client ledgers
AI Management | Configure AI profile, model preference, and budget settings
AI Execute | Invoke AI skills on entities (FICA verification, matter intake)
AI Review | Review and approve or reject AI-proposed actions
Manage take-on | Move clients, matters, trust balances and debtors from the previous system
Sign off trust take-on | Sign off a trust opening position as a partner or director (Rule 54.19)
